notes.title: Version 0.1.0 released: Wonders are coming
notes.content:
Because it is personal development, in order to ensure the quality of the game, it does not adopt the way of frequent updates, but wait for the version to be relatively stable and then release it once again.

This update includes:

1. New building category: Wonder. There are eight kinds of wonders, each of which can only be built one, but the effect is very powerful. It includes:
[list] [*]City Defense Cannon: Has super large range. It can greatly improve the defense ability of the base. [/list]
[list] [*]Air Base:  It can strengthen the air force, increase the damage of missile assistance by 30%, and increase the number of airborne robots to 4 each time. [/list]
[list] [*]Diplomatic Center: Greatly increase the level of gifts from other recycling centers to us.[/list]
[list] [*]Development Center: The working efficiency of the surrounding large-scale factories will be increased by 30%. [/list]
[list] [*]Logistics Center: The cargo capacity of the robots in the surrounding large-scale robot home will be increased by 300.[/list]
[list] [*]Solar Energy Plant: Use sunlight for large-scale power generation, work during the day, affected by the weather. [/list]
[list] [*]Arsenal: The arsenal is able to improve the ammunition to increase weapon damage of all robots by 20%.[/list]
[list] [*]Man Made Forest: This forest will reduce the natural growth of pollution by 75%, and increase the rate of natural decline of pollution by 100%. [/list]

2. New war command: Airborne. After unlocking the corresponding memory technology, airborne troops can be used when you launching a war.

3. New intercity interaction: Alliance. After unlocking the corresponding memory technology, players can ally with the recycling centers with trust over 300, and seek the reinforcements of allies when launching a war. Each ally has its own unique reinforcement robot, whose strength depends on the memory level of the player and the trust of the corresponding city.

4. Other details optimization and bugs repaired:

[list] [*]Defense tower buildings can display attack range, damage value and attack frequency. [/list]
[list] [*]Fix a bug that some battle effects don't disappear. [/list]
[list] [*]Fixed a bug in the building information interface. [/list]

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: Eliminate the competition
notes.content:
Oh, I see how it is. I see you, Walker. You’re just… you’re lucky you’re always wrong about everything, mate, or this would get messy very fast.

We like competition here in the Pleasuredome, although the thousands of games whose digital innards coat the walls might not. It is time, of course, for the last fight in the Unknown Pleasures schedule before the big one. The last chance for one of the countless little-known games on Steam to sneak in and seize a spot in the hallowed best of 2019 list. It’s already close, my friends. It is very close.

Automatically disagreeing with John on principle this week: electoral events, cowboy cutters, and robot roads.

(more…)
